parsed.impact: The description path in main.rs (`read`, `times`) and the "New event" window and full editor (`QuickEntry`, `Editor::from_quick`, `follow_start`, `timing`) use the changed code, and `Editor.start` can now be `None` for a new event. The prompt and schema change (`calendar` field, `none` kind) alters live-model behaviour for US-10-02 to US-10-04. Repeat and Custom stay inert while the start is empty.

findings.text: crates/core/src/editor.rs:524 (`follow_start`) and :776 (`timing`) — a description with neither day nor time, opened in the full editor: type a day, tick All day → "The end date can't be read." and Save stays unavailable, because `start` stays `None` and the end fields stay blank (reproduced). → Resolve the start (time midnight) in `follow_start` when all-day, or let `timing()` take an empty end date as the start date in all-day mode; add a test for it.
crates/app/src/editor.rs:725 — empty End fields show no hint while the start is asked for → give them hints, or leave them until filled.
crates/core/src/texts.rs:466 — the new hint and empty-field constants are wedged between the *_UNREADABLE constants, with only `DAY_HINT` documented → group them.
crates/core/src/described.rs (`parse`) — the part-of-day-alone exception covers only a real-model quirk and has only a unit test; it is documented in DEC-232 → leave or simplify.
crates/core/src/editor.rs:526 — `self.length.take()` runs on every call and only matters once; correct but subtle → comment or restructure.
crates/app/src/description_asked_tests.rs — no app-level test for the offline named Google calendar or for duplicate names; the core test covers duplicates, disabled, hidden and read-only → optional.
docs/specs/DECISIONS.md DEC-232 — the "96 % / 90 %" live-model score cannot be verified from the diff → none needed.

REVIEW: findings
STORY: US-10-05
IMPACT: The description path in main.rs (`read`, `times`) and the "New event" window and full editor (`QuickEntry`, `Editor::from_quick`, `follow_start`, `timing`) use the changed code, and `Editor.start` can now be `None` for a new event. The prompt and schema change (`calendar` field, `none` kind) alters live-model behaviour for US-10-02 to US-10-04. Repeat and Custom stay inert while the start is empty.
FINDINGS:
  B1 crates/core/src/editor.rs:524 (`follow_start`) and :776 (`timing`) — a description with neither day nor time, opened in the full editor: type a day, tick All day → "The end date can't be read." and Save stays unavailable, because `start` stays `None` and the end fields stay blank (reproduced). → Resolve the start (time midnight) in `follow_start` when all-day, or let `timing()` take an empty end date as the start date in all-day mode; add a test for it.
  N1 crates/app/src/editor.rs:725 — empty End fields show no hint while the start is asked for → give them hints, or leave them until filled.
  N2 crates/core/src/texts.rs:466 — the new hint and empty-field constants are wedged between the *_UNREADABLE constants, with only `DAY_HINT` documented → group them.
  N3 crates/core/src/described.rs (`parse`) — the part-of-day-alone exception covers only a real-model quirk and has only a unit test; it is documented in DEC-232 → leave or simplify.
  N4 crates/core/src/editor.rs:526 — `self.length.take()` runs on every call and only matters once; correct but subtle → comment or restructure.
  N5 crates/app/src/description_asked_tests.rs — no app-level test for the offline named Google calendar or for duplicate names; the core test covers duplicates, disabled, hidden and read-only → optional.
  N6 docs/specs/DECISIONS.md DEC-232 — the "96 % / 90 %" live-model score cannot be verified from the diff → none needed.
CRITERIA:
  #1 met — a given day or time is filled in as in US-10-02, only a missing one is asked for; TC-10-32 and TC-10-33
  #2 met — name match ignoring case in side-panel order; core test plus TC-10-34
  #3 met — no time: opens on Sat 31 Oct, time empty with the cursor in it, Save unavailable until a time or all-day; TC-10-32 passes
  #4 met — no date: day empty with the cursor in it, Save unavailable until a day is chosen; TC-10-33 passes. The neither-day-nor-time all-day case is unmet, see B1.
  #5 met — named calendar chosen, or the default with the note; TC-10-34 and TC-10-35 pass; the light and dark theme look of the asked-for fields and the calendar note is external (MANUAL, story technical note, left for the owner)
